page.overview:
Who is Sheriff Grandy?

Grandy was sheriff of the Haddonfield Sheriff's Department. He was first seen at the party organized by Lori Parker and Sally Wilson with Mayor Jamison. He and Jamison had an argument over the safety of the town after the body of Officer Baker was found murdered in the woods.

He later went to the Myers house to investigate and was murdered by Michael Myers. Matt Hudson found his body and was also attacked, but escaped. Category:Male characters Category:Minor characters Category:Victims of Michael Myers Category:Law Enforcement Category:1990s deaths
